flow-definition.description: HEADSLING 单机关卡独立资产编译与 S3 发布。默认从本地 HeadGame 源码快照构建，支持 Git 分支；iOS / Android secondary catalog 与 JSON 按同一 ContentVersion 发布，归档 SHA-256、源码指纹及日志。S3：release/headsling/config/v1，AWS profile：mcombatDev。管线源：/Users/daisei/HeadGame/Jenkinsfile.assets。

hudson.model.ChoiceParameterDefinition.name: SOURCE_MODE
hudson.model.ChoiceParameterDefinition.description: Local snapshot includes unpushed source changes; Git uses the selected branch.

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: LOCAL_SOURCE_PATH
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Read-only source for LOCAL_SNAPSHOT. Build caches and credentials are excluded.

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: EXPECTED_CONTENT_VERSION
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Optional positive version assertion. Blank reads ContentVersion from the source JSON; never changes it.

hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.name: IOS
hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.description: Build and verify the standalone iOS solo config catalog.

hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.name: ANDROID
hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.description: Build and verify the standalone Android solo config catalog.

hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.name: PUBLISH
hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.description: Publish both platform catalogs and raw config to the existing release prefix.

hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.name: VALIDATE_ONLY
hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.description: Build and validate locally; overrides PUBLISH and does not use AWS.

hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.name: CLEAN_LIBRARY
hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.description: Clear only this independent job workspace Library cache.

hudson.model.ChoiceParameterDefinition.name: AWS_PROFILE
hudson.model.ChoiceParameterDefinition.description: Existing AWS CLI profile. Credentials are never copied into the workspace.
